description: Round 2 conservative rework of GaganEA.mq5 defaults + logic to target the three diagnosed weaknesses from the Round 1 baseline (net -387.57, 41% DD, PF 0.62): (1) cut drawdown/risk, (2) reduce overtrading, (3) fix reward:risk. Also wire up the dead protection functions so master/basket protection moves real stop losses. Bump version to 2.11. Edit ONLY GaganEA.mq5, then append a Round 2 section to ITERATION_LOG.md. This is a single coherent feature because all edits live in one file and must stay mutually consistent. NO compiling/backtesting is possible in the sandbox; correctness is by read-through + MQL5 knowledge. Do NOT fabricate performance numbers. Do NOT commit or push.
steps: STEP 0 - baseline: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main; confirm working tree clean. Read GaganEA.mq5 in full before editing.
STEP 1 - CUT RISK: In the INPUT PARAMETERS block, change Risk_Percent default from 6.0 to 1.0. Leave Manual_LotSize=0.0 and Max_LotSize as-is (Max_LotSize acts as a cap).

STEP 2 - CONCURRENT-EXPOSURE CAP: Add a new input in the '=== MULTI-TRADE SETTINGS ===' group: 'input int Max_Concurrent_Positions = 2;' (a hard cap on total simultaneous EA positions for _Symbol/Magic). In OpenTrade(), before attempting a BUY or a SELL, compute total open EA positions (open_buy_count + open_sell_count is already maintained by CountOpenPositions() each tick) and skip opening if it is >= Max_Concurrent_Positions. This bounds max stacked exposure so risk cannot compound into a 40% DD. Keep the existing DistanceCheckOK() check as well.

STEP 3 - WIDEN ENTRY DISTANCE / STACKING GAP: Increase Min_EMA_Distance default from 150 to 400 (units are _Point on gold ~= $4 move) so entries only fire when price is meaningfully extended from the CTF EMA. Increase Min_Trade_Distance default from 20 to 500 (points, ~= $5) so a second same-side entry requires real separation, not ~$0.20. These are conservative defaults; note in the log they can be tuned.

STEP 4 - ENTRY COOLDOWN: Add an input 'input int Entry_Cooldown_Bars = 3;' in the MULTI-TRADE SETTINGS group. Add a global 'datetime last_entry_bar_time = 0;' near the other globals and initialize it to 0 in OnInit(). In OpenTrade(), after a successful trade.Buy()/trade.Sell(), set last_entry_bar_time = iTime(_Symbol, Trade_Timeframe, 0). Before opening either side, skip if fewer than Entry_Cooldown_Bars bars have elapsed since last_entry_bar_time (compute using iBarShift or by comparing iTime of current bar; simplest robust approach: store the bar time and require (iTime(_Symbol,Trade_Timeframe,0) - last_entry_bar_time) >= Entry_Cooldown_Bars * PeriodSeconds(Trade_Timeframe)). Guard against last_entry_bar_time==0 meaning no cooldown yet.

STEP 5 - REDUCE ENABLED PATTERNS TO RELIABLE ONES: Change the DEFAULT values of the weaker/noisier candlestick and chart pattern inputs to false, keeping only the more reliable reversal/continuation patterns ON by default. Keep ON: Use_BullEngulf, Use_MorningStar, Use_ThreeWhite, Use_BearEngulf, Use_EveningStar, Use_ThreeBlack (strong multi-candle / engulfing signals). Turn OFF by default: Use_Hammer, Use_InvHammer, Use_PiercingLine, Use_BullHarami, Use_Doji, Use_ShootingStar, Use_DarkCloud, Use_BearHarami, Use_HangingMan, and ALL chart patterns (Use_DoubleTop, Use_DoubleBottom, Use_HeadShoulders, Use_InvHeadShould, Use_BearFlag, Use_BullFlag, Use_RisingWedge, Use_FallingWedge, Use_BearTriangle, Use_BullTriangle). Only change the default literals; do NOT delete the inputs or their detection code, so the user can re-enable any of them. This directly cuts overtrading frequency.

STEP 6 - FIX REWARD:RISK (targets + stop): Rebalance the SL/target defaults so the average winner can be >= the average loser and losers are cut sooner. Set StopLoss_Pips from 2500 to 1000 (tighter stop). Move targets out and reduce how much T1 closes: T1_Pips 800 -> 500, T2_Pips 1200 -> 1000, T3_Pips 2000 -> 1800; T1_ClosePercent 65.0 -> 33.0, T2_ClosePercent 80.0 -> 50.0, T3_ClosePercent stays 100.0. Net effect: a smaller first partial that banks some profit while leaving the majority of the position to reach T2/T3, with a stop that is now ~2x the first target instead of ~3x. Keep Use_StopLoss=true.

STEP 7 - MAKE PROTECTION MOVE REAL STOPS (wire up dead functions): The individual real-SL trailing currently only runs AFTER T2 (ManageIndividualTrailing gates on t2_tickets). Add a breakeven+trailing step that engages after T1 so open winners are protected earlier: in ManageIndividualTrailing (or a small added block called from OnTick alongside it), for tickets that are in t1_tickets but not yet trailed, move the SL to at least breakeven (entry price) once price is beyond T1, and continue trailing by Trail_Step_Pips. Prefer to REUSE the existing ApplyTrailingToTickets(t2_tickets, Trail_Step_Pips) by actually calling it (it is currently dead) OR fold its logic in; whichever keeps the code simplest and correct. Ensure the master EP path also protects real SLs: in CheckMasterEquityProtection, when a master trail is active, call the now-live ApplyMasterTrailing(POSITION_TYPE_BUY/SELL, Master_Trail_Step) to move real SLs in addition to the existing CloseAllByType safety net. Do not leave ApplyMasterTrailing/ApplyTrailingToTickets defined-but-uncalled. Keep all modifications minimal and ensure PositionModify respects broker stop levels (guard newSL relative to current price/open as the existing code already does).

STEP 8 - VERSION BUMP: Change '2.10' -> '2.11' and 'GaganEA v2.10' -> 'GaganEA v2.11' everywhere it appears: the header comment (lines ~2), #property copyright (line ~15), #property version (line ~16), the OnInit Print (line ~282), the OnDeinit Print (line ~304), and the dashboard title label in CreateDashboard (' GaganEA v2.10' near line ~1393). Optionally update the top-of-file KEY FINDINGS comment block to note this is the Round 2 conservative build, but keep it ASCII.

STEP 9 - LOG: Append a new '## Round 2' section to ITERATION_LOG.md using the per-round template already in that file. State the hypothesis (attack survival first: cut risk, cut overtrading, fix reward:risk, wire up real-SL protection) and list the EXACT parameter/logic changes made and their INTENDED effect. Do NOT invent any metrics/results (Key metrics = 'pending next backtest'). Keep it ASCII.

STEP 10 - SELF-VERIFY: Re-read the full modified GaganEA.mq5. Confirm: no undeclared identifiers, balanced braces, new inputs declared in a valid 'input' group, new globals declared and initialized, all changed defaults consistent, ApplyMasterTrailing/ApplyTrailingToTickets now called, version string fully bumped (grep for '2.10' should return nothing in GaganEA.mq5), and no new raw non-ASCII bytes were introduced. Do NOT commit or push.
acceptance_criteria: Only GaganEA.mq5 and ITERATION_LOG.md are modified (git status shows no other changed files).
Risk_Percent default is 1.0; StopLoss_Pips is 1000; T1/T2/T3 are 500/1000/1800; T1/T2/T3 close percents are 33/50/100.
A Max_Concurrent_Positions input exists and OpenTrade() refuses to open when total open EA positions >= that cap.
An Entry_Cooldown_Bars input exists and entries are suppressed until the cooldown elapses after the last entry; last_entry_bar_time global is declared and initialized.
Min_EMA_Distance default is 400 and Min_Trade_Distance default is 500.

Default-enabled patterns are exactly: Use_BullEngulf, Use_MorningStar, Use_ThreeWhite, Use_BearEngulf, Use_EveningStar, Use_ThreeBlack; all other candlestick and ALL chart pattern inputs default to false; no pattern input or detection code was deleted.
ApplyMasterTrailing and ApplyTrailingToTickets are each called at least once (no longer dead); an after-T1 breakeven/trailing protects open winners before T2.
All occurrences of the 2.10 version string in GaganEA.mq5 are changed to 2.11 (grep '2.10' in GaganEA.mq5 returns nothing), including the dashboard title.
ITERATION_LOG.md has a new Round 2 section describing the hypothesis and exact changes with no fabricated performance numbers.
No new raw non-ASCII bytes introduced into GaganEA.mq5 or ITERATION_LOG.md.
OnInit/OnTick structure and the dashboard are preserved (still created/updated).
No commit or push was performed.

Run: grep -n "ApplyMasterTrailing\|ApplyTrailingToTickets" GaganEA.mq5 -> expect BOTH definitions AND at least one call site each.

Read-through verification: brace balance, no undeclared identifiers, all changed input defaults match the acceptance criteria, PositionModify guards preserved. (No MQL5 compiler available in sandbox; this read-through plus the user's next MT5 backtest is the authoritative check.)
findings:
All 10 steps implemented in GaganEA.mq5; Round 2 section appended to ITERATION_LOG.md. Changes: Risk_Percent 6.0->1.0; StopLoss_Pips 2500->1000; T1/T2/T3 800/1200/2000 -> 500/1000/1800; T1/T2 close 65/80 -> 33/50 (T3 100); Min_EMA_Distance 150->400; Min_Trade_Distance 20->500. New inputs Max_Concurrent_Positions=2 and Entry_Cooldown_Bars=3 added to MULTI-TRADE SETTINGS; new global last_entry_bar_time declared and initialized in OnInit; OpenTrade() now returns early when open_buy_count+open_sell_count>=cap and enforces the bar cooldown, setting last_entry_bar_time after each successful Buy/Sell. Default-ON patterns reduced to exactly Use_BullEngulf, Use_MorningStar, Use_ThreeWhite, Use_BearEngulf, Use_EveningStar, Use_ThreeBlack; all other candlestick + ALL chart patterns default false (no inputs/detection code deleted). Dead functions wired up: ManageIndividualTrailing now calls new ApplyBreakevenToTickets(t1_tickets) for after-T1 breakeven and calls ApplyTrailingToTickets(t2_tickets, Trail_Step_Pips) for after-T2 trailing; CheckMasterEquityProtection now calls ApplyMasterTrailing(BUY/SELL, Master_Trail_Step) while a master trail is active. Version bumped v2.10->v2.11 in header comment, #property copyright/version, OnInit/OnDeinit prints, and dashboard title. Verification (sandbox, no MQL5 compiler/MT5): grep '2.10' returns nothing; ApplyMasterTrailing/ApplyTrailingToTickets each have definitions + call sites; braces balanced (172/172) and parens balanced (896/896); no NEW raw non-ASCII bytes in added lines of either file (pre-existing dashboard escaped glyphs and pre-existing en/em dashes left untouched); git status shows only GaganEA.mq5 and ITERATION_LOG.md modified. OnInit/OnTick structure and dashboard preserved. Note: MQL5 allows calling functions defined later in the same file (file-wide scope), so the call-before-definition ordering is valid. No commit/push performed per instructions. Authoritative pass/fail is the user's next MT5 Strategy Tester backtest on Windows.

FOLLOW-UP (v1 semantic review, APPROVED but 3 behavioral concerns): Addressed the trailing-distance issue and justified the other two, editing ONLY GaganEA.mq5 + ITERATION_LOG.md. (1) TIGHT LIVE TRAILS FIXED: the newly-live real-SL trails multiply *_Pips by _Point (same raw-point unit as StopLoss_Pips/T1_Pips per the EA's convention). Old defaults were far too small in that unit ($0.30/$0.15 trails, $0.30 arm) and inside XAUUSD noise. Kept the unit math consistent (still * _Point) and raised the DEFAULT input values to sane gold distances comparable to the ~500-pt T1: Trail_Step_Pips 30->400 (~$4); Basket_Lock_Pips 30.0->500.0 and Basket_Trail_Step 15.0->250.0; Master_Lock_Pips 30.0->500.0 and Master_Trail_Step 15.0->250.0. Lock (500) >= trail step (250) in both basket and master paths so the trail still arms sensibly. (2) MASTER-TRAIL SUMMED METRIC: left as-is and justified - the per-ticket PositionModify inside ApplyMasterTrailing uses each position's own open/current price so the stop MOVE is per-position correct; only the trigger is aggregate, bounded by Max_Concurrent_Positions=2. (3) FULL STOP UNTIL T1: left by design and justified - protecting before T1 would tighten stops inside noise and recreate the premature-stop-out problem. Documented all three in the ITERATION_LOG.md Round 2 section.
